status: post-hoc sensitivity; does not replace the pre-specified primary
definition: Preserves the existing Phase 2 interval exclusions and five-second restart buffer. For intervals containing a later foul/free-throw before the buffered endpoint, adds trades strictly before the first such PBP event. Existing eligible quiet timeout and quarter-break trades remain included.
limitations: The sensitivity retains Phase 2 interval-level exclusions and the five-second restart buffer, both of which use later event or restart information.
ESPN wall-clock timestamps have one-second resolution and their common absolute lag relative to market timestamps is unknown.
This is a post-hoc timing sensitivity, not a fully trade-time-identifiable estimate.
